notes: Two concurrent muse REPL sessions launched in the SAME cwd via the interactive driver's start_session step (record ports start_session/session from a slot-model sibling driver before this can run). Each muse process mints its OWN session UUID as its session-directory basename (session_id = dir basename, format-spec §1), so the two distinct session_ids are asserted via new_session/same_session_as relations, not literal ids. Every identity-pinning phase anchors on a WORKING transition, never ready: muse's process scanner (CommandPattern, wired unconditionally in cmd/irrlichd/wiring.go) emits a transient proc-<PID> presession row born in ready before the real transcript is discovered, and a ready-anchored new_session phase would greedily bind to that placeholder. Phase order follows the recipe: s1 turn -> start_session -> s2 turn -> s1 turn again. Tokens are durably persisted (model_completed.usage, format-spec §6) so tokens_nonzero is asserted true; no cost field exists anywhere in the corpus and muse's model has no aliases.go pricing entry, so cost_nonzero is asserted false, not left unset.
